title: MORPH — Letters That Transform
description: A kinetic typography piece — the wordmark MORPH splits into glyphs that each rotate, skew, and scale in a staggered loop, so the letters never sit still. Purple fill, a soft purple glow, and a chromatic edge that splits the type into cyan and magenta ghosts. Letters that feel alive.
